conversations.text: Brewers just won their first World Series, 4-1 over Rays.
Do they get extra brats with cheese now?
Wait, but fifty-seven years is a long thirst.
LeVar Burton's memoir drops November tenth, 352 pages.
Cool, can he beam me past my homework?
Wait, but will my tired eyes last all that?
Bryan Adams dropped a 12-track love letter to Canada this week.
Should we blast it while eating maple pancakes?
Wait, but twelve songs? Will I snooze halfway?

Talk about skipping stones and hitting jackpot history!
Wait, but was he just chucking rocks around ruins?
Found today in Assam, a new white star flower, six feet tall!
My dandelions just quit, feeling short now!
Wait, but only a few left near roads, right?

Milwaukee must need a bigger cheese trophy shelf now!
Wait, but what do longtime losing fans do now?
Kawaguchi lights its maple tunnel nightly till nine, starting Saturday.
So trees get nightlights and I still need permission?
wait, but will crowds squish those old roots?

I already shared my fries, that's one down!
wait, but who's counting all those smiles?

Finally horses outshine wizards on posters!
Wait, but will it startle my old pony?

Wait, but who keeps track of a billion?

Wait, but do second-year wonders get sleepy legs?

Can we live inside a lamp? Snacks taste glowier there.

India beat New Zealand by five wickets in rainy Auckland.
Did the clouds try to field too, all drippy?
Wait, but was that soggy chase really fair?
Godzilla Minus Zero opens wide November sixth, filmed for IMAX.
Cool, giant lizard finally gets the extra-big popcorn screen.
Wait, but will my ears survive all that stompy rumble?
Dilwali Diwali hits Netflix tomorrow, about grandparents and home.
So we cry, hug Mom, steal the popcorn?
Wait, but do I have to share blanket?
Choros Island petrels grew from 12,000 to 90,000 pairs
Rabbits moved out, so birds took the whole couch
Wait, but will tiny burrows fit that crowd?
New Cat in the Hat lands Friday, Bill Hader voices Cat.
Finally, a hat that cleans its own mess?
Wait, but will it still feel Seussian and cozy?
